This is a key pre-sales page - prospects often check this to understand how to work with Netofficials. Tone: clear, decisive, helps the reader choose confidently. || PRIMARY KEYWORD: software development engagement models | SUPPORTING: project based development India, dedicated development team model, staff augmentation model India | SEMANTIC: fixed-price project, time and materials, dedicated team, staff augmentation, resource augmentation, outsourcing models, engagement model comparison || CONTENT SCOPE: 1. Opening: Netofficials offers three engagement models - 2 sentence intro | 2. Model 1 - Project-Based: you bring a defined scope, Netofficials delivers to a fixed price and timeline. Best for: well-defined projects, one-off builds, clients who prefer predictable cost. Includes: discovery, development, QA, deployment, 30-day post-launch support. Pricing: fixed price agreed upfront based on scope. | 3. Model 2 - Dedicated Development Team: a team of developers, designers and/or QA engineers working exclusively for you, managed by you, located at Netofficials in India. Best for: product companies needing ongoing development, startups scaling their team, companies replacing expensive in-house headcount. Pricing: monthly team rate per engineer (quoted based on skills and seniority). You get: same team, same standups, same tools as your in-house team. | 4. Model 3 - Staff Augmentation: individual engineers placed within your existing team, working under your direction. Best for: teams needing to fill a specific skill gap (React developer for 3 months, DevOps engineer for a project). Pricing: monthly rate per resource. | 5. Comparison table as prose: Project-Based suits defined scope with fixed budget; Dedicated Team suits continuous product development; Staff Aug suits filling a specific short-term skill gap | 6. How to choose: If you have a defined spec and want a fixed price, choose Project-Based. If you are building a product long-term and want a team that feels in-house, choose Dedicated Team. If you have an in-house team with a specific skill gap, choose Staff Augmentation. | 7. Pricing overview: transparent USD/GBP monthly rates, no recruitment fees, no hardware costs, rates vary by seniority (junior / mid / senior / lead). | 8. FAQ - 5 questions: can I switch models mid-project / is there a minimum commitment / what happens if a team member leaves / do I get to interview the team / what is included in the monthly team rate || HEADING STRUCTURE: H1: Engagement Models | H2: Three Engagement Models | H3: Project-Based | H3: Dedicated Development Team | H3: Staff Augmentation | H2: Comparing the Three Models | H2: How to Choose the Right Model | H2: Pricing Overview | H2: Frequently Asked Questions || SEO: Primary keyword in H1 and first paragraph.
